name: rezis-codeflow
description: Call graphs, flowcharts, and sequence diagrams for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and Rust, in VS Code and Cursor. Analysis stays local.

virtualWorkspaces.description: CodeFlow analyzes source files on disk.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CodeFlow reads workspace source to build diagrams and does not run in Restricted Mode.

codeflow.editor.followCursor.description: When the cursor moves in a TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or Rust file, highlight that symbol in the open diagram and pan to it. This does not lay the diagram out again.
codeflow.editor.followCursor.markdownDescription: When the cursor moves in a TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or Rust file, highlight that symbol in the open diagram and pan to it. This does not lay the diagram out again.

codeflow.editor.refocusOnCursor.description: In focus mode, when the cursor moves to a symbol that is not in the current diagram, replace the diagram with that symbol's neighbourhood. When this is off, CodeFlow shows "Not in this diagram" instead.
codeflow.editor.refocusOnCursor.markdownDescription: In focus mode, when the cursor moves to a symbol that is not in the current diagram, replace the diagram with that symbol's neighbourhood. When this is off, CodeFlow shows "Not in this diagram" instead.

codeflow.editor.callDepth.description: How many call steps CodeFlow: Show Callers, CodeFlow: Show Callees, a request flow, and a sequence walk. The route itself is not a step.
codeflow.editor.callDepth.markdownDescription: How many call steps **CodeFlow: Show Callers**, **CodeFlow: Show Callees**, a request flow, and a sequence walk. The route itself is not a step. From 1 to 32.

codeflow.codeLens.enabled.description: Show caller and callee counts above each function and method. The counts are the direct call-graph degree. Uncertain calls are shown separately as "+N possible" and are not included in the main count. Clicking the caller count runs Show Callers. Clicking the callee count runs Show Callees.
codeflow.codeLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Show caller and callee counts above each function and method. The counts are the direct call-graph degree. Uncertain calls are shown separately as "+N possible" and are not included in the main count. Clicking the caller count runs **Show Callers**. Clicking the callee count runs **Show Callees**.

enumDescriptions: Draw the neighbourhood around the symbol (depth 2).
Draw the whole graph and highlight the symbol.
codeflow.view.defaultMode.description: Diagram opened by CodeFlow: Show Flow for Symbol at Cursor. focus draws the neighbourhood around the symbol (depth 2). workspace draws the whole graph and highlights the symbol. The toolbar toggle changes this for the open panel. Trait map, request flow, control flow, and sequence are opened by their own commands.
codeflow.view.defaultMode.markdownDescription: Diagram opened by **CodeFlow: Show Flow for Symbol at Cursor**. `focus` draws the neighbourhood around the symbol (depth 2). `workspace` draws the whole graph and highlights the symbol. The toolbar toggle changes this for the open panel. Trait map, request flow, control flow, and sequence are opened by their own commands.

codeflow.view.maxNodes.description: Maximum number of nodes the diagram draws at first. The panel can show 100 more at a time, up to 2,000. A snapshot larger than 2,000 nodes is not posted, and the panel says how many were left out. This also caps trait-method fan-out and a request flow.
codeflow.view.maxNodes.markdownDescription: Maximum number of nodes the diagram draws at first. **Show 100 more** raises that up to 2,000. A snapshot larger than 2,000 nodes is not posted, and the panel says how many were left out. This also caps trait-method fan-out and a request flow.

codeflow.exclude.description: Glob patterns for files and folders CodeFlow does not analyze. node_modules is always skipped. Rust analysis also skips target/. Python analysis also skips venv, .venv, and __pycache__. These patterns are combined with files.exclude.
codeflow.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for files and folders CodeFlow does not analyze. `node_modules` is always skipped. Rust analysis also skips `target/`. Python analysis also skips `venv`, `.venv`, and `__pycache__`. These patterns are combined with `#files.exclude#`.

codeflow.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files CodeFlow analyzes for each language in each workspace folder. TypeScript, Python, and Rust are capped separately. The first diagram uses a smaller neighbourhood and does not wait for this cap.
codeflow.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum number of files CodeFlow analyzes for each language in each workspace folder. TypeScript, Python, and Rust are capped separately. The first diagram uses a smaller neighbourhood and does not wait for this cap.

codeflow.cache.enabled.description: Store per-file analysis in this window's storage so the next diagram can open from disk. CodeFlow: Clear Cache deletes it. Turning this off skips the disk and does not delete an existing cache.
codeflow.cache.enabled.markdownDescription: Store per-file analysis in this window's storage so the next diagram can open from disk. **CodeFlow: Clear Cache** deletes it. Turning this off skips the disk and does not delete an existing cache.

codeflow.rust.useRustAnalyzer.description: When the rust-analyzer extension is installed and already running, use its call hierarchy to mark calls from the focused Rust symbol as certain. Tree-sitter still builds the graph when this is off or rust-analyzer is not active. CodeFlow does not install or activate rust-analyzer.
codeflow.rust.useRustAnalyzer.markdownDescription: When the rust-analyzer extension is installed and already running, use its call hierarchy to mark calls from the focused Rust symbol as certain. Tree-sitter still builds the graph when this is off or rust-analyzer is not active. CodeFlow does not install or activate rust-analyzer.

codeflow.savedFlows.storeInWorkspace.description: Write named flows to .codeflow/flows.json so they can be committed. When this is off, CodeFlow keeps them in this window's workspace storage.
codeflow.savedFlows.storeInWorkspace.markdownDescription: Write named flows to `.codeflow/flows.json` so they can be committed. When this is off, CodeFlow keeps them in this window's workspace storage.

codeflow.export.pngScale.description: Pixel scale for CodeFlow: Export PNG. 1 is the diagram's layout size. 2 is sharper on a high-density screen.
codeflow.export.pngScale.markdownDescription: Pixel scale for **CodeFlow: Export PNG**. `1` is the diagram's layout size. `2` is sharper on a high-density screen. From 1 to 4.

enumDescriptions: Force a white background for PNG and SVG.
codeflow.export.background.description: Background for PNG and SVG export. theme follows the current color theme. light forces a white background.
codeflow.export.background.markdownDescription: Background for PNG and SVG export. `theme` follows the current color theme. `light` forces a white background.

codeflow.ai.enabled.description: Explain the open diagram in plain language. Off sends nothing. On uses the provider below.
codeflow.ai.enabled.markdownDescription: Explain the open diagram in plain language. Off sends nothing. On uses the provider below.

enumDescriptions: The editor's language model through the VS Code Language Model API. No API key.
An OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint, including a local server such as Ollama.
Anthropic's messages API, or a compatible base URL.
codeflow.ai.provider.description: Who explains the diagram. editor uses the editor's model. The other two use your API key.
codeflow.ai.provider.markdownDescription: Who explains the diagram. `editor` uses the editor's language model. `openai-compatible` and `anthropic` use your API key.

codeflow.ai.modelFamily.description: Family passed to the editor model selector, such as gpt-4o. Empty uses the first model returned.
codeflow.ai.modelFamily.markdownDescription: Family passed to the editor language model selector, such as `gpt-4o`. Empty uses the first model the editor returns. Used only when the provider is `editor`.

codeflow.ai.model.description: Model id for an own-key provider. Empty uses gpt-4o-mini or claude-3-5-haiku-20241022.
codeflow.ai.model.markdownDescription: Model id for `openai-compatible` or `anthropic`. Empty uses `gpt-4o-mini` or `claude-3-5-haiku-20241022`. Ignored for the editor provider.

codeflow.ai.baseUrl.description: Base URL for an own-key provider. Empty uses the provider default. Must start with http:// or https://.
codeflow.ai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for `openai-compatible` or `anthropic`. Empty uses the provider default. A local server can be `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`. The value must start with `http://` or `https://`.

codeflow.ai.snippetChars.description: Maximum characters of source copied from each node into an explanation. 0 sends names and edges only.
codeflow.ai.snippetChars.markdownDescription: Maximum characters of source copied from each node into an explanation. `0` sends names and edges only. Maximum 2000.
